# Mouse: Species Guidance

Mouse simulations should state whether the material represents inbred strains,
outbred stocks, recombinant inbred lines, Diversity Outbred, Collaborative
Cross, or a controlled cross. Sex chromosomes, sex-specific recombination,
known pedigree, cage/litter effects, and maternal effects can all affect trait
and association simulations. Preserve animal, dam, sire, litter, generation,
and cage metadata separately.
